snippets.en: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
snippets.tr: Então lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: Eis que eu tomarei a vara de José que esteve na mão de Efraim, e das tribos de Israel, seus companheiros, e as ajuntarei à vara de Judá, e farei delas uma só vara, e elas se farão uma só na minha mão.

snippets.en: … by scriptures of the Restoration.[^26] Prophecies that the stick of Joseph (the Book of Mormon) and the stick of Judah …
snippets.tr: … escrituras da Restauração.[^26] As profecias de que a vara de José (o Livro de Mórmon) e a vara de Judá …

snippets.en: - The “stick of Judah” and the “stick of Joseph” will become one.
snippets.tr: - A “vara de Judá” e a “vara de José” serão unidas.

snippets.en: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
snippets.tr: Diles: Así ha dicho Jehová el Señor: He aquí, yo tomo el palo de José que está en la mano de Efraín, y a las tribus de Israel, sus compañeros, y los pondré con él, con el palo de Judá, y los haré un solo palo, y serán uno en mi mano.

snippets.en: … by scriptures of the Restoration.[^26] Prophecies that the stick of Joseph (the Book of Mormon) and the stick of Judah …
snippets.tr: … Se han cumplido las profecías de que el palo de José (el Libro de Mormón) y el palo de Judá …

snippets.en: - The “stick of Judah” and the “stick of Joseph” will become one.
snippets.tr: - El “palo de Judá” y el “palo de José” llegarán a ser uno.
